toegepas.rede_vinder: One plucks (tokkel) a string in Afrikaans; 'trek' reads as pulling it.
toegepas.fout: 'n snaar trek' uses the wrong verb; a string is plucked (tokkel), not pulled.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Wrong verb replaced with the right one; the contrast with blown and struck instruments is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma closes the embedded relative clause before the main verb, so the subject reads clearly.
toegepas.fout: The verbs of the relative clause and the main clause collide ('skraap is') with no comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma where two clauses' verbs meet is standard Afrikaans punctuation and helps a Grade 4 reader find the main verb.

toegepas.voor: slaan die vel met 'n stok en die groot vel
toegepas.na: slaan die vel met 'n stok, en die groot vel
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both 'n Speler slaan' and 'die groot vel gee' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Die danser se eie voete skud hulle.
toegepas.na: Die danser se eie voete laat hulle skud.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'hulle' can be read as the subject shaking the feet; 'laat hulle skud' removes the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'voete skud hulle' is slightly unclear: 'hulle' can read as reflexive, and feet do not literally shake an object.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'laat hulle skud' says the same thing, that the feet and not the hands make the rattles shake, more clearly.

toegepas.voor: Die klank is hoog en kort en dit val
toegepas.na: Die klank is hoog en kort, en dit val
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; also separates it from the list 'hoog en kort'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('Die klank is' and 'dit val').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required comma, and it separates the clause boundary from the list 'hoog en kort'.

toegepas.voor: Al die slaginstrumente saam is een familie
toegepas.na: Al die slaginstrumente saam vorm een familie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'saam vorm' is more natural than 'saam is' for a group making up a family.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'saam vorm een familie' is the natural expression for things that together make up a group, with the same meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: An instruction to listen for something is 'luister of' in Afrikaans; imperative 'hoor of' is unidiomatic.
toegepas.fout: Imperative 'Hoor eers of' is unidiomatic for an instruction to listen out for something.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Luister eers of' is the natural Afrikaans instruction and keeps the same task and order.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as above: 'luister of', not imperative 'hoor of'.
toegepas.fout: Imperative 'Hoor dan of' is unidiomatic, as in item 10.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as item 10; repetition of 'luister' suits a step-by-step instruction for Grade 4.

laat_vaar.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar.voor: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele van Zimbabwe
laat_vaar.na: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele in Zimbabwe
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Avoids the repeated 'van ... van' chain; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A preposition swap for style only; 'van Zimbabwe' matches the shared hosho wording and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Two stacked attributive adjectives read more naturally with a comma than with 'en'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n hoë en droë klank' is natural Afrikaans; the comma form is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the natural form at the end of the phrase and matches the hosho block.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'met sand of klippies binne' is idiomatic (the shared hosho definition uses the same form); lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural preposition for words taken from the lesson.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die woorde van hierdie les' is natural; swapping to 'uit' is a lateral preposition change.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'gedroog' is the simpler, more natural verb form than 'droog gemaak'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'droog gemaak' is correct, plain Afrikaans, and this is a glossary definition, so a stylistic rewording is not worth it.

laat_vaar.voor: so lank duur soos twee kwartnote
laat_vaar.na: so lank duur as twee kwartnote
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The comparison of equality is 'so ... as' in Afrikaans, as the kwartnoot entry already has it; 'so ... soos' is wrong.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The halwenoot definition is protected word for word, and both 'so ... soos' and 'so ... as' are accepted Afrikaans, so this is not a fault.

vlae.rede: Check the music term: Afrikaans usually speaks of 'n tweeslagmaat / vierslagmaat (or twee- of vierslagmaat); 'viermaatslag' may be a CAPS term, so not changed.

vlae.teks: Die instrumente in 'n familie is nie regtig familie van mekaar nie.
vlae.rede: 'familie van mekaar' is colloquial; 'aan mekaar verwant' is more standard but would lose the deliberate play on 'familie', so left for a person.
